snippet.title: Witch’s Apocalyptic Journey Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Witch’s Apocalyptic Journey is a co-op roguelite deckbuilder and strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic fantasy world. Build powerful spell decks, manipulate a fate-based timeline system, recruit NPCs, and shape branching outcomes across run-based progression. Supports single-player and up to 4-player online co-op with deep card synergy, relic upgrades, and strategic event sequencing.

Steam Store: ▶https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709430/Witchs_Apocalyptic_Journey/ 

#AnimeGame #Roguelike #Deckbuilder
